Emma James


University of California San Franscico


Emma James is the Project Archivist with the Industry Documents Library (IDL), hosted by the UCSF Library. The IDL is a digital archive of documents created by industries that have impacted public health in various areas including tobacco, opioids, other drug industries, chemical, food, and fossil fuel.
Emma has an interest and background in managing digital collections and digital preservation, which supports her role working with the IDL’s most recent collection of Juul Labs documents, and contributing to the IDL’s goals for future-proofing and managing digital collections of 20 million documents and growing.

The Digital Health Humanities Toolkit was developed at the University of Californa San Francisco thanks to a grant from the National Endowment for the Humanities.
